text:
Anya: Wehave T-10 days to GA. I want a tiny, sign-off friendly checklist that product managers can hand to execs: SLA metrics + exclusions, API freeze + delta doc, docs quickstart + migration notes, support rota + pager ladder, monitoring + cost alerts, pricing tiers + intro terms. Who takes each line?
Priya: I'll own the checklist template and the acceptance rubric (owner, pass/fail criteria, evidence link). Will add a severity matrix for incidents.
Diego: I'm on SLA and rollback rules. Proposal: Hosted SLA 99.9% uptime; p99 soft 350ms / hard 600ms. Dedicated SLA 99.95%; p99 soft 275ms / hard 450ms. Maintenance windows: Dedicated requires 48h notice; Hosted receives console notice 4h prior except emergencies.
Kat: Docs: I'll ship a short quickstart (<5min), an "API delta" summary for SDK users, and a migration table for renamed params. Need API freeze by Fri EOD to lock examples.
Sam: Pricing: Recommend Dev (metered, free tier), Standard (metered + soft quota), Enterprise (committed + flat invoice). Introduce a limited-time GA discount for the first 12 weeks. I need Diego's cost-per-token estimates to finalize numbers.
Rae: Ops/support: plan for 72h elevated oncall starting at GA with 2-person primary per shift + 2 backups. Escalation ladder: SRE -> Eng lead -> Product -> Exec. I'll publish the rota and contact cards.
Legal-Bot: Ryan assigned. I'll draft a concise SLA appendix and a pilot SOW addendum. Product, mark any features in private preview that should be excluded from the SLA.
Priya: Checklist fields: owner, target, evidence link (GH/PR/logs), rollback plan, sign-off (yes/no). I'll open the GH checklist now and @owner each row.
Diego: Scheduling perf runs Tue/Wed; if p99 misses soft target, request permission for a temporary capacity bump and enable fallback model variant. I'll attach perf logs to the GH issue.
Kat: I'll include an "If things go wrong" snippet in quickstart linking to the runbook and communication templates.
Sam: Finance note: for Dedicated GA customers we should prefer committed flat billing for predictability; will model overage terms.
Rae: Also adding dashboards: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, requests/sec, token-cost per request, KV cache hit rate, GPU util. Alerts: p99>600ms, error-rate>1% sustained 5m, cost-anomaly >25% 15m.
Anya: Action owners recap: Checklist + rubric -> Priya, SLA -> Diego, Docs -> Kat, Pricing -> Sam, Support rota -> Rae, Legal wording -> Ryan. I'll track GH checklist and run final triage next Thu 10am PT.
ops-bot: Staging deploy (sha 8b7c2d) succeeded. Smoke tests passed.
Priya: GH checklist live, pinging owners. Please post evidence links as items complete.
Diego: Perf logs will be uploaded after tests. If metrics look marginal, I may open a soft-gate request to buy tuning time.
Kat: API freeze Fri EOD noted. I'll cut PRs shortly after.
Sam: Will draft provisional GA pricing tiers and the intro discount proposal by Wed, pending Diego's cost numbers.
Rae: Rota draft will be posted Tue; Eng leads please confirm names.
Anya: Thanks all. Use this thread for any last-minute swaps or escalations.
